keyPoints.en: Reid Commission formed after the London Agreement (1956).
keyPoints.bm: Suruhanjaya Reid dibentuk selepas Perjanjian London (1956).

keyPoints.en: It received 131 memoranda; the Alliance memorandum carried the inter-ethnic agreement.
keyPoints.bm: Ia menerima 131 memorandum; memorandum Perikatan membawa persetujuan antara kaum.

keyPoints.en: The Constitution came into force on 31 August 1957.
Constitutional monarchy: Yang di-Pertuan Agong (Art. 32), elected by the Conference of Rulers for 5 years.
keyPoints.bm: Raja berperlembagaan: Yang di-Pertuan Agong (Perkara 32), dipilih Majlis Raja-Raja untuk 5 tahun.

keyPoints.en: Islam (Art. 3); supreme law (Art. 4); freedom of religion (Art. 11).
Citizenship: operation of law, registration, naturalisation.
keyPoints.bm: Kewarganegaraan: kuat kuasa undang-undang, pendaftaran, penaturalisasian.

keyPoints.en: Parliamentary democracy and separation of powers.

tip.en: Mnemonic for the big four Articles: 3-4-152-153 = Islam, Supreme, Language, Special.
tip.bm: Ingat empat Perkara utama: 3-4-152-153 = Islam, Tertinggi, Bahasa, Istimewa.

keyPoints.en: It is the supreme law and the framework of government.
keyPoints.bm: Ia undang-undang tertinggi dan rangka pemerintahan.

keyPoints.en: It protects fundamental liberties of every citizen.
keyPoints.bm: Ia melindungi kebebasan asasi setiap warganegara.

keyPoints.en: It records the social contract, keeping unity and stability.
keyPoints.bm: Ia merekodkan kontrak sosial, mengekalkan perpaduan dan kestabilan.
